rdfs:label: Email
rdfs:comment: An email address — the value class for `urn:solid:hasEmail` when the email is described as a typed resource rather than a bare `mailto:` IRI.
notes: Class form pairing with the existing `hasEmail` property. vCard's two encodings: (1) `hasEmail` directly to a `mailto:` IRI for simple cases, or (2) `hasEmail` to an `Email`-typed resource with `vcard:value` (mailto IRI) plus role classes like `Home`/`Work` for typed addresses. Use this class for the typed-resource form.
